svg.aria-label: Attention came before the Transformer. 2014, additive attention inside an RNN encoder-decoder for translation: the previous decoder state s_(t−1) is scored against each encoder RNN state h1 to h5 by a tiny network, v·tanh(W s_(t−1) + U h_j), a softmax over j turns the scores into weights, and the weighted sum of the h_j, c = Σ α_j h_j, is the context vector. 2015, multiplicative attention: the same setup, but the current decoder state s_t is scored as s_t·W·h_j, a single matrix multiply with no tanh, so it is cheaper. 2017, the Transformer: no RNN, every token queries every token in self-attention with score softmax(q·k/√d), and several heads run side by side, each with its own W_Q, W_K and W_V, concatenated and projected by W_O. What 2017 added was the √d scale, many heads, and dropping the RNN.
